title: 1RB0LE_1RC1RB_1RD0RA_0RE---_1LF1LA_1LA1LF: the list-machine reduction carries over (Lean)
text: This machine is the table of 1RB0RE_0RC---_1LD1LE_1LE1LD_1RF0LC_1RA1RF started in another state. That machine's Lean files on absorption, walls, crossings, the right end and witnesses hold here with the states renamed, and a new start lemma (first right turn at step 48) gives: if the list machine never fails from that state, the machine never halts. It has not failed in 40,000 list steps.
